What is This Part?
This is the RHD Parking Brake Cable #1 for the Suzuki Samurai.
72 Long This cable goes from the Hand Brake Lever to the Rear Brake Drum.
Note: There is also an Emergency Brake Cable #2 which is sold separately.
Note: This cable is for the European/Asian RHD Model.
We also carry the American LHD Cable in our eBay Store.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Parking Brake Cable #1 (RHD)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
